fields.description: CRC32-IEEE (poly 0xEDB88320, init 0xFFFFFFFF, xorout 0xFFFFFFFF) over logical block bytes [0,64) with the stored word treated as zero. Schema v2 has no crc32 algorithm, so the stored word is exposed as a plain field; see SPEC.md.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020e64 builds the 256-entry CRC table (shift-xor with polynomial param), FUN_08020ed8 runs the table update crc=table[(crc^byte)&0xff]^(crc>>8), FUN_08020f80 wraps it with init 0xFFFFFFFF and final inversion, and FUN_080210a8 verifies this word per 64-byte block (zeroes word at block+4, compares recomputed value). Value 0x5e2e6f38 verified against samples/baseline.sav in the rev8-logical domain with two independent implementations.
fields.name: settings_crc32
